To add your first product in Kaizena Flow, go to the Products section in your store admin and click on "Add product." Then provide a title, a price, and a picture for the product, and finally press Save. This will create your product in the store. If you want, I can open the relevant docs page for you.

I cannot delete products in your store directly. However, I can guide you on how to delete every product in your store e2e-shop from the Kaizena Flow admin.

To delete products in your store:

1. Log in to your Kaizena Flow admin.
2. Go to the Products section.
3. You can select products individually or use bulk actions to delete multiple products.
4. Confirm the deletion.

If you want API or programmatic guidance for deleting products, please let me know if you run the store or develop on it. Then I can assist accordingly.

A 401 error on GET /products means the Admin API token is missing, unknown, or revoked. Make sure your token is correct, active, and included properly in the request headers as authorization. Do not share real tokens in chats; replace it with a placeholder in examples. If the token is newly created, verify it hasn't been revoked or expired. If the problem persists, you may need to check your token's permissions or regenerate it in the admin. If you want, I can guide you on how to set the token correctly or where in the admin to manage API tokens.
